title: GTA 6 Just Broke the Pre-Order Record on PlayStation AND Xbox 🏆 #Shorts
description:
On November 10, 2026, Sony said Grand Theft Auto VI is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history, and Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said it's the most pre-ordered game ever on Microsoft Store. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said pre-orders are far exceeding expectations, without sharing numbers. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: PlayStation Blog, Xbox (Asha Sharma), Insider Gaming, GamesIndustry.biz. Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
